newsitem.title: BELGIUM: MOBISTAR LAUNCHES COMPANY GSM PACKAGE.
newsitem.headline: MOBISTAR LAUNCHES COMPANY GSM PACKAGE.

text.p: Belgo-French Mobistar NV, which operates Belgium's second GSM mobile phone network, said on Wednesday it would launch a package of mobile phone services, aimed at the business sector and giving easy Internet access.
"Mobistar wants to position itself predominantly (in the market) of professional users of mobile telephone technology," Mobistar said in a statement.
On March 16, Mobistar will launch the 'Duo' package which will enable clients to use two mobile phones through the simultaneous use of two SIM cards on the same telephone number.
It said it had developed additional services linked to fax and electronic transmissions, allowing direct access by mobile phone to e-mail systems.
"For the first time in Belgium, the users of mobile telephones will be able to have access to the Internet," the company said.
It said Mobistar would also offer an SMS service (Short Message System), allowing mobile phone users to receive e-mail messages on their phone screens.
Mobistar is 62-percent owned by France Telecom. Belgian data communication company Telinfo NV has 10 percent and and a group of eight other Belgian investors 28 percent.
